name: rosetta-fibonacci-word
code:
use default
use System.Math

words() -> Pipe[string] is
    let earlier mut = "1"
    let later mut = "0"

    yield earlier

    while true do
        yield later

        let next = "{later}{earlier}"

        earlier = later
        later = next
    od
si

entropy(word: string) -> double is
    let counts = MAP()

    for character in word do
        let seen mut = 0

        counts.try_get_value(character, seen ref)

        counts[character] = seen + 1
    od

    let total = cast double(word.length)

    counts.values
        |> map(count => cast(count) / total)
        |> reduce(0.0D, (bits, probability) =>
            bits - probability * Math.log2(probability))
si

write_line("   N      length            entropy")

words()
    |> take(37)
    |> index(1)
    |> each(word =>
        (let bits = entropy(word.value)
         write_line("{word.index,4}{word.value.length,12}{bits,20:F15}")))
